description: Canonical structuredContent shape returned by the search_papers MCP tool. Frozen by E06_S04; bumped at E13_S02 to widen snippet.maxLength for the <retrieved_chunk> delimiter wrapping (Threat 2 defense). Bumped at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m1 for paper_id filter wiring (Field description change; output shape unchanged). Bumped at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m2 to add the optional filters_applied echo field. Bumped at verification-feedback-m1 (and again at its rectification) to track the TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise for the cite_neighbors handler wiring (this search_papers result shape is unchanged — the version field tracks server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION globally). Bumped at verification-feedback-m3 (11 -> 12) to track the lean_verify tool addition; this search_papers result shape is unchanged. Bumped at textbook-ingest-m3 (12 -> 13) to track the SEARCH_PAPERS ToolMeta description edit that documented the textbook:<slug> paper_id form in filters validation; the result-row shape is unchanged (the textbook chunk_id pattern was already widened at textbook-ingest-m1 via the chunk_id.pattern mirror below). Bumped at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 (13 -> 14) to ADD the per-row source_kind enum property (arxiv|textbook) + its required entry — the first result-row SHAPE change of the textbook family. Bumped again at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 rectification (14 -> 15) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the critique-F3 filters-parameter inputSchema description fix; this result-row shape is unchanged at the 14 -> 15 step. Bumped at textbook-ingest-m11 / e5 (15 -> 16) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the get_chunk truncated_for_license response flag; this search_papers result-row shape is unchanged at the 15 -> 16 step (the license-truncation flag lands on get_chunk only, not on search rows). Bumped at paper-metadata-m2 (16 -> 17) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the GET_PAPER ToolMeta description rewrite — get_paper now serves hydrated title/authors/abstract/year/categories from the per-notebook paper-metadata store; this search_papers result-row shape is unchanged at the 16 -> 17 step. Bumped at source-truth-m5 (17 -> 18) to track the get_chunk +5 source-truth response fields, and at license-serving-removal-m1 (18 -> 19) for the REMOVAL of the get_chunk truncated_for_license flag; this search_papers result-row shape is unchanged at both steps. The byte-stability test in E06_S06 hashes this file's bytes and pins the SHA-256; any drift is a deliberate bump. The ``version`` field below MUST equal server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION (cross-checked by tests/test_snippet_contract.py). Bumped at lean-verify-continuation-m1 (19 -> 20) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the lean_verify env/proof_state continuation parameters + the env/proof_state_id/continuation_status output fields + the tactic_step mode; this search_papers result-row shape is unchanged at the 19 -> 20 step. Bumped at agent-platform-m3 / W1 (20 -> 21) to ADD the per-row title + year properties (semantic-identifiers join from the PaperMetadataStore) — a real result-row SHAPE change — alongside the batched TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise carrying the W1 description deltas, inert-arg removals, batch get_chunk, and ToolAnnotations. SHAPE CHANGE at issue #204 (Tier-2 scope key) WITHOUT a version bump, deliberately: the optional cache_match provenance object was added. version still reads 21 because it tracks the global server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION, and bumping THAT drifts the tools/list bytes via the _meta.tool_schema_version echo — a re-pin the repo mints only in a batched window, and the W1 window already closed at agent-platform-m3. The behaviour therefore merges first and the version bump is staged in .claude/docs/w1-schema-deltas.md alongside the lean_verify axiom_audit delta (issues #205 / #281 / #332), which made the identical call. Consequence to know: between now and that bump, a consumer keying on the version integer cannot distinguish this shape from the pre-#204 v21 shape — key on the PRESENCE of cache_match instead, which is meaningful precisely because the field is ABSENT (not null) whenever the rows did not come from the Tier-2 cache.

cache_match.description: Provenance of a Tier-2 semantic-cache hit (issue #204). PRESENT ONLY when the rows came from the Tier-2 ring buffer; ABSENT means they were computed for this exact query (a fresh pipeline run, or an exact Tier-1 memo whose key includes the verbatim query, k, filters, level, corpus_version and embedder identity). kind='approximate_neighbor' means the rows answer a DIFFERENT query whose embedding sits within the 0.97 cosine threshold of this one — before this field existed, such a neighbour's rows were returned shaped byte-identically to an exact hit with nothing on the wire to distinguish them. This is a PROVENANCE axis and is independent of every other trust field: it is not 'degraded' (an operational-fallback axis) and it is not an epistemic outcome — an approximate hit is a real, complete answer to an adjacent question, never an abstention or a partial result (CLAUDE.md 4.9 trust-language policy).

cosine.description: Cosine similarity between this query's embedding and the cached entry's, in [0.97, 1.0] (the Tier-2 threshold is the lower bound), rounded to 4 decimal places. 1.0 accompanies kind='exact_query_embedding'.

kind.description: 'exact_query_embedding' — the hit was this query's own embedding (the ring-buffer dedup slot); the subject is your query, served from cache and therefore up to the 15-minute Tier-2 TTL stale. 'approximate_neighbor' — the rows were retrieved for a nearby but DIFFERENT query.

corpus_version.description: The integer corpus_version pinned at server startup (per E04_S03's corpus-version.json marker). Echoed in every tool result envelope so the agent can correlate cached results.

embed_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model used at retrieval time. v1: 'bge-m3'. Pinned constant — bumps invalidate downstream caches.

excluded_kinds.description: Chunk kinds NOT included in the result set. v1: ['proof'] — the dual-encoding schema puts proof bodies in embedding_proof which is not yet retrievable until E07's dual-column RRF lands. Programmatic detector for the v1 limitation.

filter_warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about filter / cursor args that were accepted but not yet processed. v1 ignores the filters and cursor args (deferred to E07_S04); when set, this array carries one string per ignored arg.

filters_applied.description: Echo of the filter actually honored by this call. Absent when no filter was passed. Only contains keys from server.handlers.search.SUPPORTED_FILTER_KEYS (currently: paper_id). The paper_id list is sorted and coerced to list[str] per server.handlers.search._canonicalize_filters. Downstream agents use this to verify scoping without re-parsing filter_warnings. Added at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m2.

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results. v1: always null (pagination deferred to E07_S04).

results.description: Per-chunk result rows, sorted (score_desc, chunk_id_asc). Each row is the canonical search-result object frozen by this milestone.

items.description: One search result. NOT a chunk — agents call get_chunk(chunk_id) to fetch the full body. The snippet content is a byte-for-byte slice of body_text (max 150 chars of content), no LLM rewriting. The snippet field itself wraps the content in <retrieved_chunk>...</retrieved_chunk> delimiters per Threat-2 defense (E13_S02; .claude/docs/security-threat-2-audit.md). The wrap adds 35 chars of fixed overhead plus up to 6 chars per literal delimiter occurrence escaped in the body — maxLength: 250 covers the worst case.

chunk_id.description: Content-addressable chunk_id. Two prefix shapes (textbook-ingest-m1): arxiv:<paper_id>:<16-hex> for arXiv chunks and textbook:<slug>:<16-hex> for notebook-scoped textbook chunks. Stable across re-chunks of the same source bytes. Pattern mirrors ingest.identifiers.CHUNK_ID_PATTERN (single source of truth, locked by tests/test_snippet_contract.py::TestRegexSourceOfTruth).

label.description: Human-readable theorem label (e.g. 'Theorem 3.4'). Built from theorem_name + theorem_label. Empty string when neither is populated.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier without source prefix. Two shapes (textbook-ingest-m1 + m3): (a) arXiv — e.g. '2401.00001' or 'hep-th/9876543', optionally with a 'vN' version suffix; (b) textbook — 'textbook:<slug>' where <slug> matches the notebook-slug regex [a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}. The chunk_id field above pins the canonical regex for both branches.

score.description: Cosine similarity in [0.0, 1.0] (computed as 1 - L2_distance / 2 over L2-normalized BGE-M3 vectors). Higher is more similar.

section_path.description: Section breadcrumb from the chunk's source paper (e.g. ['Section 3', 'Subsection 3.1']). Empty list when the chunk has no section context.

snippet.description: First 150 characters of the chunk's canonical body text (column body_text in the LanceDB chunks table; conceptually body_canonical per design note 04), wrapped in <retrieved_chunk>...</retrieved_chunk> delimiters as a prompt-injection defense (E13_S02 Threat 2). Open and close tag occurrences inside the body content are HTML-escaped before wrapping (escape-on-emit). NO LLM rewriting, NO ellipsis. Agents that need the full body call get_chunk(chunk_id). The 150-char limit applies to the content INSIDE the delimiter; the field's maxLength of 250 accommodates 17-char open tag + up to 198 chars of escaped content + 18-char close tag.

source_kind.description: Origin corpus of the chunk (textbook-ingest-m9 / e4). 'arxiv' for shared-corpus / arXiv-paper chunks; 'textbook' for notebook-scoped textbook chunks (MinerU+LaTeXML pipeline). Mirrors the chunks-table source_kind enum column. Filterable via filters.source_kind in the search_papers request.

title.description: Human-readable paper title joined from the PaperMetadataStore (agent-platform-t-semantic-identifiers), so an agent can read a result list without a get_paper round-trip per row. Null when the store is absent, the paper is not yet backfilled, or a notebook-routed search hit a paper absent from the shared store. Non-null values are arXiv-authored free text: sanitized and wrapped in <retrieved_chunk>...</retrieved_chunk> delimiters (Threat 2), the same treatment as snippet.

year.description: Publication year joined from the PaperMetadataStore, or null when unavailable or unparseable (the store's year==0 sentinel).

retrieval_mode.description: Active retrieval mode. v1: 'dense_only' (BGE-M3 ANN over embedding_stmt). E07 will add 'hybrid_rrf' when BM25 + RRF lands; later 'hybrid_rrf_reranked' once the BGE-reranker is wired.
